# Conformance fixtures

Generated by the intel-feed conformance generator (Phase 1, planned as `intel-feed/cmd/conformance-gen`). **Never edit these files by hand.** Regenerate them and review the diff.

Every generation writes a `PROVENANCE.json` with:

- the SHA-256 of the generator source;
- the intel-feed commit, plus the SHA-256 of the source tree it ran against (the tree hash catches uncommitted changes);
- the Go version;
- the generation time.

The fixture families and the acceptance gate are defined in [ADR-004](../../docs/decisions/ADR-004-feed-client-faithfulness.md#conformance-fixtures). Empty until Phase 1.
